operators.name: custom_pad2d

parameters.name: input
parameters.layout: strided, possibly non-contiguous; implementation should handle via copy to contiguous output using source strides

semantics: Corresponds to self.padding(x) with ZeroPad2d(padding_amount), where padding_amount = (left, right, top, bottom).
The output is a new tensor of shape computed from input shape and padding amounts.
Padded regions are filled with zeros; inner region is copied from input respecting input strides.
The custom op must produce a contiguous tensor to maintain reference output stride [Hout*Wout, Wout, 1].
No bias or broadcasting in this step.

operators.name: custom_mean_dim

parameters.name: input
parameters.layout: strided, but the output of custom_pad2d is contiguous; implementation may assume contiguous or handle strides

semantics: Corresponds to torch.mean(x, dim=self.mean_dim), where self.mean_dim is an integer (2 in the task).
Reduces over the specified dimension by computing arithmetic mean (sum divided by size of that dimension).
The output shape is the input shape with dimension `dim` removed.
Must preserve the reference output stride [Hout*Wout, Wout, 1] (contiguous for the reduced dims).
No extra broadcasting; output dtype float32.
Applies ZeroPad2d with padding (1,2,1,2) to input of shape [N,C,H,W].
Zero padding inserts zeros on the left (1), right (2), top (1), bottom (2) of the last two spatial dimensions.
Output is a new contiguous tensor on CUDA.
Computes mean over dimension self.mean_dim (2 in task).
Input shape [512,3,515,515], dim=2 removes the height dimension.
Uses arithmetic mean, no keepdim, output float32 on CUDA.
Returns the reduced tensor of shape [512,3,515].
